maya: Heads-up — packaging team wants to switch to the delta-merge flow for the Private VPC RC-8 tonight. Staging window 23:00 UTC. Plan: repack -> cosign -> push to offsite mirror -> atomic mirror swap by deploybot. Need signoff on KMS rotation, cosign keys, and checksum/rollback criteria.
liam: What's the exact rollback criteria? checksum mismatch only, or also image start failures within 10 minutes?
sophia: prefer two-tier: checksum mismatch -> immediate holdback; runtime health failures (k8s probes / start crashloop) -> automatic rollback to previous sealed bundle within 10m, manual confirm if >10m.
manita: typo: i'm anita (ops). KMS rotation window conflicts with today's maintenance at 23:30. Can we avoid rotating keys tonight?
maya: good catch anita — we won't rotate KMS tonight. We'll use existing signing key and rotate in the next stable window. Update: cosign expiry checks still required.
release-coordinator: Schedule notes: canary target = 2 customer mirrors, max 15% traffic routing for first 30m. If canary OK, promote to all mirrors over 60m. If canary fails, immediate mirror-swap rollback.
sam: adding small preflight checklist I ran locally:
```
# preflight (local)
sha256sum installer.tar.gz => 3a7f...9b
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/redwood/cosign-keys/packaging-key installer.tar.gz
jq .manifest.meta release-manifest.json | grep rc-8
kubectl -n redwood get deploy redwood-runtime -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions}'
```
liam: deploybot, can you run a dry-run promote and report potential conflicts with current mirror locks? @deploybot
deploybot: scheduled dry-run for manifest id=rc-8-delta-20260321 at 2026-03-21T22:45:00Z. No lock conflicts detected. Potential issues flagged: 1) mirror B has < 20% free disk, 2) cosign key TTL is 4d (warning). See log: `/var/log/deploybot/dryrun-3299901234.log`
sophia: mirror B disk <20% — we should exclude it from canary and target mirror A + sandbox mirror only.
ops-bot: mirror exclusion update applied: mirrors=[A,sandbox]. Annotation: excluded mirror B due to disk pressure. :white_check_mark:
manita: confirm: if any checksum mismatch during repack -> we stop and revert to previous signed manifest, right?
maya: yes. Rollback decision tree (short):
1) checksum mismatch during packaging or cosign verify fails -> abort publish, alert eng-releases, no mirror swap.
2) successful publish but canary runtime failures within 10m (>=2 replica crashes OR readiness <50%) -> automatic swap back to previous manifest.
3) data-plane degradations (latency/regression > 2x baseline) -> manual rollback after 15m RW consult.
4) human abort -> immediate halt and postmortem required.
liam: sounds good. Who's owner for the mirror-swap rollback?
sophia: oncall infra for immediate rollback ops. Packaging lead (maya) to coordinate release notes and postmortem if triggered.
sam: release notes to include: changed delta packaging for offline bundles, no KMS rotation, excluded mirror B, canary mirrors list, cosign key id, checksum sha256. Example snippet to put in notes: `Bundle: rc-8-delta-20260321 | cosign-id: packaging-key-v2 | sha256:3a7f...9b`
release-coordinator: I'll publish the release notes to private-release-notes doc and ping enterprise customers in the 22:00 UTC notice.
maya: final ops checklist before 23:00 UTC (short):
- [x] build delta bundle
- [x] local cosign verify
- [x] store sha256 in signing table
- [x] mark mirror B excluded
- [ ] deploybot atomic dry-run (complete)
- [ ] start repack + cosign at 23:00
- [ ] monitor canary 30m
liam: adding a quick rollback command for oncall: 
```
# rollback to previous sealed manifest
/deploybot mirror-swap --to-manifest=sealed-rc-7-20260215 --force --reason="canary-failure"
```
sophia: I'll watch the canary metrics dashboard and keep the 10min check window. Ping me in thread if you start the swap.
maya: starting repack in 15m. tagging this thread with :shipit: and will update when cosign step completes.
deploybot: action=promote-dryrun status=success manifest=rc-8-delta-20260321 locks=none warnings=["cosign_ttl_4d","mirror_b_disk<20%"]
ops-bot: canary targets set to [mirrorA, sandbox] and traffic ramp policy applied.
release-coordinator: noted — sending 22:00 customer heads-up. Good luck, team. :rocket:
maya: cosign completed at 23:06 UTC, sha256 recorded: 3a7f5c...9b. Starting mirror push now.
liam: pushing to mirrors. keep watchers on logs: `tail -f /var/log/packaging/push.log`
(continued monitoring)
deploybot: mirror-push status=partial succeeded=2 failed=0 pending=0 manifest=rc-8-delta-20260321
ops-bot: atomic mirror swap scheduled at 23:14 UTC.
sophia: canary metrics steady for first 7m. no crashes.
manita: all good from infra vantage.
maya: canary promoted to full rollout at 23:45 UTC per plan.
release-coordinator: marking release as completed in Jira ticket PACK-4821. Will kickoff post-release health check tomorrow.
liam: thumbs up. :thumbsup:
maya: closing thread. If anyone hits issues, reopen or start a new thread and reference this timestamp.
